errors.description: Credenciales de autenticación inválidas o no autorizadas
errors.resolution: Verify FEL_API_USER and FEL_API_KEY are correct and the account is active with Infile.

errors.description: Acceso denegado: el usuario no tiene permisos para esta operación
errors.resolution: Contact Infile support to verify account permissions and flow authorization.
Wait until the daily reset (midnight Guatemala time) or request a limit increase from Infile.

errors.description: NIT del receptor no existe en el RTU de SAT Guatemala
errors.resolution: Verify the recipient tax ID with Rtu::lookupNit() before issuing the DTE.

errors.description: NIT del emisor no está habilitado para FEL
errors.resolution: Ensure your company NIT is registered and active in the FEL program with SAT Guatemala.

errors.description: XML del DTE tiene formato inválido o no cumple con el esquema XSD de SAT
errors.resolution: Call $invoice->validate() before issue() to catch XSD errors without consuming a transaction.

errors.description: La firma digital del DTE es inválida
errors.resolution: Verify FEL_SIGN_USER and FEL_SIGN_KEY. The signing token may have expired — request a new one from SAT.

errors.description: DTE duplicado: ya existe un documento certificado con el mismo identificador
errors.resolution: This is the idempotency system working correctly. The original DTE UUID is returned. No action needed.

errors.description: Error interno en el sistema de certificación de Infile
errors.resolution: Retry with exponential backoff. If the error persists, contact Infile support with the idempotency key.

errors.description: El servicio de certificación de Infile no está disponible temporalmente
errors.resolution: The SDK will activate CAFE contingency mode automatically. DTEs will be retried when service is restored.
